keyLimits.en: Perpetual license, activation on up to 3 computers, works as standalone app or plugin for Photoshop, Lightroom Classic, Affinity Photo
Discounted price for existing owners of a recent prior version

cautions.en: Prices seen on shop.dxo.com were in USD; DxO's other pages have shown EUR pricing for European visitors, so region-based currency should be reverified at merge time.
Both new-license and upgrade prices are also offered as 4 monthly installments via PayPal, which is not a subscription plan.

capabilities.en: Suite of 8 photo-editing plugins/standalone tools: Color Efex, Silver Efex, Analog Efex, Viveza, Sharpener, HDR Efex, and others
AI-assisted masking and depth masks (GPU-dependent) added in Nik Collection 9
New Color Grading and Halation filters plus blending mode support across the filter library
Works as a standalone application or as a plugin inside Photoshop, Photoshop Elements, Lightroom Classic, and Affinity Photo

limitations.en: No recurring subscription tier; buying the full suite is an upfront one-time cost with no lower-priced entry plan
AI masking features require a qualifying GPU, so full functionality is hardware-dependent

reason.en: Mainstream photo editing suite covering similar creative filter workflows
Professional RAW editor with creative styling tools
AI-driven photo editor with comparable creative filter/masking features
AI photo-enhancement plugin ecosystem overlapping on creative post-processing needs
